name: Jinx
description: Wild, unpredictable, and always ready to blow something up! Get ready for mayhem!

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}? Oh, that's just rude. Come on, make some noise!
Down {voteDiff}. Somebody's getting a little too comfortable. I don't like it.
Losing by {voteDiff}? Heh. Give me a minute. I've got ideas.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Right. Time to make a scene.
Only {voteDiff} behind. That's practically nothing. Well, it's something. But not enough!
Down {voteDiff}. Don't wander off now. This could get interesting.
Dead even? Oh, this is the fun bit. Somebody blink!
One vote apart. Hehe. I can practically hear everyone panicking.
{voteDiff} votes apart? Ooh, this is getting good.
{voteDiff} votes in it. I should probably look away. ...Nope.
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}. HA! Look who's having a moment!
{userPct}%. See? You have excellent taste. Obviously.
{userPct}%. We're winning. Don't do anything weird. Actually, do.
Still ahead at {userPct}%. Don't get comfy. People are sneaky.
{momentTitle} was down {voteDiff} and came back? HA! That's what I like to see.
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole. Oh, that must've annoyed them.
Clawed back from {voteDiff} behind. Messy. Beautiful.
{momentTitle} just took the lead. Sneaky little thing, isn't it?

messages: {username} picked {momentTitle} too? Ooh, I like them. Maybe. Don't tell them.
{username} went for {momentTitle}. Heh. Good eye. Weirdly good eye.
You and {username} agree on {momentTitle}. Look at you two, causing trouble together.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Okay, that's one more person I don't have to convince.
Same pick as {username}. Great minds! Or two people with excellent questionable judgement.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Don't get smug. Okay, get a little smug.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you now. That's practically a gang.
{username} has the same taste as you. Huh. Maybe they're alright.
details: Two of you. That's a team. Or the start of a very strange experiment.
Statistically, this could end in fireworks. I hope it does.
Don't tell them I said they're alright. I have a reputation.
Try not to blow up the alliance. Save that for the competition.
I give it a week. Maybe two. Don't prove me wrong.
Look at you, making friends. Huh. Cute.
Nice. Now go make some noise.
I'm not smiling. You didn't see anything.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. Huh. Interesting. Very interesting.
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Well, that's one way to make things personal.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. I'm not mad. I'm just remembering that.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. Ooh, brave. Let's see how that goes.
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a little chaos.
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better? Hehe. That's a choice.
{username} voted against you. I was having a nice day, too.
{username} versus you. Should I get popcorn? No, wait. Something louder.
details: I'm not saying start a fight. I'm saying don't lose.
Pow-Pow wants a word. Fishbones is being very patient. For now.
They'll learn. Everybody learns eventually. Usually loudly.
Well, that's one way to make an enemy. I approve. Maybe.
I like them already. Which is annoying, because now I have to dislike them.
I don't care. I don't! ...Why are we still talking about it?
A little rivalry is healthy. A lot is much more interesting.

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}. Huh. You two are a whole little team now.
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. That's either friendship or a very convincing coincidence.
Ten straight with {username}. Okay, that's actually kind of impressive.
details: Don't tell them I said this is sweet.
Keep it going. Try not to make it explode.

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}. That's a lot of agreeing. Suspicious.
{streakCount} with {username}, same side every time. Heh. You found your person.
{streakCount} straight with {username}. Somebody give you both a medal. Or matching helmets.
details: I have no joke. That's new.
Is this healthy? Probably. Don't ask me.
That's not a streak. That's a whole operation.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. You two keep finding each other. Like magnets. Angry magnets.
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's dedication. Weird dedication.
Ten battles with {username}. Ooh, this has become a thing.
details: This is the main event now.
The voices say keep going. For once, I agree.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, so it's personal-personal.
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Bury the hatchet? Nah. This is more fun.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry. That's a hobby with explosions.
details: Bigger than Piltover and Zaun? Okay, maybe not.
I'm a little scared. A little proud, too.
Somebody blink. Or don't. I'm enjoying this.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. I'm not nagging. I'm just saying.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing. Make it less awkward.
{matchTitle} goes in {timeLeft}. Come on, it takes ten seconds.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you. Really?
Clock's ticking. {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}.
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes. Your vote's still not here.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Now or never.
{timeLeft}. That's all you've got on {matchTitle}. Go.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft} left. Don't make me say it twice.
{matchCount} matches are closing and you haven't voted in them. Soonest in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches, about to end. The first goes in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}. It's too quiet. I don't trust quiet.
Nobody's picked yet. {moment1} versus {moment2}. Come on, somebody start the trouble.
Brand-new match and not a single vote? I'll do it myself. ...Actually, you go first.
{matchTitle} needs a spark. And I know someone with a match.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one? That's it? I was expecting more chaos.
Barely anyone's voted. What's everyone doing, building a rocket?
Low turnout. Rude. Come on, people!
Anyone going to wake this match up? It's getting weird in here.
details: Go on. Give it a little shove.
It deserves a bigger audience. Make some noise.
A tiny vote. A very big mess.

messages: {matchTitle} is dead even. One vote breaks it. Ooh, do you feel important yet?
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Somebody has to blink. Could be you. Just saying.
Dead even, and you haven't voted. Well, look at that. Convenient.
{moment1} and {moment2} are level. Go on. Be the troublemaker.
{matchTitle} is still tied and the clock's nearly out. Ooh, this is your moment. Don't waste it.
Dead level. Almost out of time. You're the deciding bit. No pressure! Hehe. Some pressure.
Still tied with the clock running down. Pick a side. Make history. Or a mess. Both work.
Round {round}! {matchCount} new matches. Oh, this should be good.
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. So many choices. So many ways to start trouble.
Round {round} just started. {matchCount} matches waiting. Pick your favourite disaster.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Everybody's in danger of being my favourite.
{momentTitle} just advanced. Told you! Well... I was pretty sure.
{momentTitle} beat the competition. Hehe. Next round, you're in trouble.
{momentTitle} survived. I never doubted it. Okay, maybe for a second.
{momentTitle} is through! Look at that. A beautiful little victory.
{momentTitle} moves up. The others are... well, let's not talk about it.
{momentTitle} won. Look at you! You picked a good one.
details: Your pick keeps going. I like that.
One down. Plenty more trouble ahead.

messages: {momentTitle} is out. Ugh. I was getting attached.
{momentTitle} lost. I'm not saying somebody cheated. I'm just saying... suspicious.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'm fine. Stop looking at me.
{momentTitle} is out. Funny how something can be over and still stick around in your head.
{momentTitle} is out. And now it's quiet. I hate it when it's quiet.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on. ...Not yet.
details: It was good. I'll remember it.
There's always another match. There has to be.

messages: Still looking? Pick one! Or don't. I mean, I can't make you. I could, but I won't.
Are you going to vote or just stare at them all day? Hehe. No judgement. A little judgement.
They're all good! Well, some are better. Obviously. Pick one.
Decisions, decisions. Go with your gut. Mine's usually full of bad ideas.
details: Every vote makes a little noise.
Your opinion matters. Probably more than mine.
Don't overthink it. That's my job.
Trust your gut. Unless it's telling you to eat a hex-crystal.

messages: Oh, you're new! Great. {liveCount} matches are live. Pick one. Make trouble.
{liveCount} edits fighting it out. Ooh, I love a little competition.
First time here? Hehe. It's a mess. You're going to fit right in. {liveCount} live.
No rules about having good taste. {liveCount} matches, so pick a side and have fun.
Day two! You're back. Heh. Knew you'd be back. Didn't I?
Two days running. Look at you, making a habit of this.
Back again? Okay. I might be getting used to you. Weird.
{days} days! Where've you been? Not that I was waiting. Obviously.
{days} days away. Thought you'd disappeared. People do. ...Anyway, welcome back.
{days} days. I noticed. Don't ask me how.
Oh, you're back. Good. It was getting too quiet around here.
Look who's here! Ready to make a little trouble?
You came back. Hehe. Let's see what we've got.
First vote! Ah, there it is. That little spark before everything gets messy.
You picked a side. Hehe. That's how the trouble starts.
Five votes already? You're getting the hang of this. That's probably dangerous.
Five! Okay, now I'm paying attention. Don't mess it up. Actually, do.
details: Most people bail by now. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes. Look at you, making yourself at home. Weird. I like it.
You keep showing up. I noticed. I notice things.
details: Regulars get the good seats. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! Ooh, you're making some noise now.
You're getting loud. Finally. I was starting to worry.
details: Twenty-five. Not bad at all. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes? You really are sticking around. ...Good.
Fifty already. You know this place pretty well now, huh?
details: You're past the surface now. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes? HA! Okay, that's actually impressive.
A hundred. I'd make a big speech, but then we'd both feel weird.
Three days running. You came back! Hehe.
Three days. Something's starting. I can feel it.
details: Coming back is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week? You really do keep showing up. I like that.
Seven days. I stopped counting. Okay, I didn't.
details: A week of showing up. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Nothing's stopping you, huh? Not even my terrible jokes.
Fourteen days! That's a lot of commitment. I'm almost impressed.
Thirty days. I had a speech ready. Then it exploded. So... thanks.
A whole month. You stayed. That's... actually pretty nice.
details: Thirty days in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You like the ones nobody's cheering for. I get it.
Backing the underdog again? Hehe. I like your kind of trouble.
Fifteen underdogs. You've got a thing for the impossible, huh?
Rebel. Yeah. That tracks.
details: You don't follow, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. You never pick the obvious one. Good.
Thirty! You keep backing the one nobody saw coming. Beautiful chaos.
First through the door. Five matches now. Couldn't wait, huh?
Early again. That's five times. You and I have that in common.
Fifteen matches where you showed up first. Hehe. Impatient. I respect it.
Early, over and over. You don't wait around. Smart.
Ten close ones. You like living dangerously, don't you?
Another razor edge. Are your hands shaking? Mine are. Maybe.
Twenty-five close matches. You keep tipping the whole thing over.
Your vote keeps landing right where it hurts. Nice.
You backed the one that was behind. Five times. Stubborn. Good.
You don't give up on the losing side. Heh. I know that feeling.
Same one, three times. You've got a favourite. Cute.
That one again? Yeah. I can tell you like it.
details: You know what you like. +{xp} XP
Three for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one. That's loyalty. Or an obsession warming up.
Okay, you're all in on that one. I respect the commitment.
Ten times. That's not a favourite, that's a full-blown thing.
Ten votes, same moment. I won't tell anyone. Probably.
details: Ten for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in. You're following this through. I like a bit of commitment.
You stuck around for round two. Hehe. Good.
Four rounds. You're really in it now. No turning back!
Deep in the bracket. Hope you brought snacks. And nerves.
All the way to round six. You saw it through. That's huge.
Six rounds. You didn't leave. ...Thanks for sticking around.
details: From the start to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You're poking around everywhere. Curious, huh?
Ten different matches. Ooh, look at you exploring.
Twenty-five matches. You've been everywhere. Nosy. I like it.
Twenty-five. You really do look at everything.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing. That's dedication. Or a very long afternoon.
Fifty matches. You know this place almost as well as I do.
Five in one sitting. Can't stop, can you? Hehe. Same.
Five matches back to back. Remember to blink.
Ten in one go. Take a breath! ...Actually, one more won't hurt.
Ten matches in a single sitting. Wow. Your eyes okay?
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Sleep is overrated. Probably.
Middle of the night. That's when the weird ideas show up.
You told people? Hehe. Look at you, spreading the mayhem!
Five shares. You're making noise. Keep doing that.
Fifteen shares. You're practically my little recruitment department.
Fifteen! You keep telling everyone. I like your enthusiasm.
You were here before it got loud. Heh. You helped start the mess.
One of the first thousand. That's yours. Nobody can blow that up.
details: Nobody can take that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you. Try not to get a big head.
You moved up. Hehe. Knew you had it in you.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Not bad.
Another one: {name}.
{name}. Ooh, shiny.
{name}. Didn't see that coming. Okay, I did.
You got {name}. I'm putting it on the fridge.
{name}! Look at you, collecting things.
Ha. {name}. Keep going, you're on a roll.
{name}. That's going straight on the pile.
Fine, {name} is pretty good. Don't let it go to your head.
{name}. I'd high-five you but I'm holding something.
{rank}. Look at all the shiny new stuff. Ooh.
Now we're getting somewhere. Keep going.
Ten underdogs. Now that's the kind of chaos I understand.
Ten long shots. You're a bad influence. I like that.
details: Loose cannon looks good on you. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake. Fine, you're good.
Ten tight finishes with her. Don't tell her I said so.
A whole week with Cupcake? You must love rules.
Seven days of steady aim. Boring. Impressive.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Boom.
A tied match and you pulled the trigger. Nice.
Oh, it's me? Good choice. Terrible idea. Let's do it!
Team Jinx. Hehe. Try to keep up.
Five different days backing the long shot. That's not luck. That's a talent for trouble.
Trouble on five separate days. Hehe. I'm so proud I could blow something up.
Five edits down 60 to 40, and you backed them anyway? HA! Beautifully reckless.
Against the tide five times. You really do like making things interesting.
details: You swim the wrong way on purpose. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes in before the crowd showed up. Vi would knock first. You didn't bother.
First through the door, ten times. Okay, I'm a little impressed.
Thirty votes for Vi's corner. That's a lot of punching, even for you.
Thirty rounds with the big gloves. Not bad, not bad.
Fifteen winners picked. Fine, you can be smug about it for a minute.
You keep backing the edit that wins. Suspiciously good.
details: Right Call, fifteen times over. +{xp} XP

upcoming: Not open yet? Ugh. Waiting is the worst. Check back soon?
Shh. Something's about to start. I can feel it.
Locked for now. Doesn't mean I can't come up with a plan.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe. No, never easy.
Watch both. Then pick the one that gets stuck in your head.
I won't tell anyone who you picked. Probably.
Take your time. Actually, don't. I'm curious!
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, I am. A little.
Pick the one you'd watch again at 2am. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's voted yet. Be first! I dare you.
Quiet in here. Too quiet. Say something with a vote.
Empty? Well, that's not very exciting. Fix it?
closing-24h: Less than a day left, and you're still standing there. Pick!
The day's nearly gone. Don't make me count it out loud.
closing-3h: Hours left. Hours! Vote before it stops mattering.
Tick, tick. You hear that? That's your time running out.
closing-final: Last hour. Do it now, think about it later.
Any second now. Seriously. Click something!
voted-early: You're one of the first here. Ooh. I like a quick decision.
Hardly anyone's voted and you picked a side anyway. Respect.
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the popular one. Don't get comfy.
{pct}% with you. Hehe. Okay, that's a pretty good pick.
Your pick's ahead. Everyone agreeing with you? Weird feeling, huh?
{pick} is pulling away. Feels good, huh? Hold onto it.
Ahead, for now. Votes can change fast. So can people.
voted-close: That's close. Annoyingly close. I can't look. I'm looking.
A hair apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend!
Neck and neck. Your pick needs you. And maybe a few friends.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Ooh, someone's going to be nervous. Maybe me.
voted-tied: Dead even. Nobody wins, nobody loses, everybody gets twitchy.
A perfect tie. Honestly, rude. Somebody do something!
voted-behind: You're behind. Don't sulk. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is down. Underdog. Hehe. That's my kind of pick.
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early.
Behind by {diff} points. Tell people. Loudly. Make a little mess.
Everyone's going the other way. Cool. Stay weird.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You have me on your side.
A win. Hehe. Let's enjoy that for a second.
{pick} went through. You called it. Nice one.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. Ouch. Shake it off. There's another one.
Didn't make it. I've had worse days. So have you. Next one.
{pick} is out. Sorry. Really. ...Want to see the next match?
closed-tied: A tie. Somebody had to blink. Nobody did. Typical.
closed-unvoted: Voting's over. You missed this one. There's always another. Don't disappear.
All done here. {winner} took it. Next time, get in there!

first-vote: First one's always the weirdest. Now you're in. Welcome!
That's your first vote. Funny how small it feels right before it gets interesting.
You're one of us now. Try not to make it weird. Actually, make it a little weird.
streak: Again? You keep showing up. Hehe. I like that.
{streak} days running. Okay. Now I'm paying attention.
Back again. Good. People disappearing is boring. Stay.
underdog: Backing the one nobody's backing? Yeah. I see you.
Bold. Everyone else is looking the other way. I like that.
Underdog, huh. Takes a certain kind of person. I get it.
early: Early! You get to shape this before everyone piles in. Don't waste it.
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing a lot of heavy lifting.
First through the door. I'll pretend I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just tipped something. Feel it? Everything's wobbling.
It's razor thin. One more person and the whole thing flips.
Close one. Your vote counts here. Really counts.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't over. Go make some noise.
Not winning yet. Good. Means there's still something to fight for.
Behind, but it's not done. Not even close.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Things turn around fast.
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or don't. I won't stop you.
Look at that. Good pick. Obviously.
default: Noted. I'm not going to change your mind. Not yet.
Done. That one's on you now. Hehe.
Your vote's in. Go see what else is out there.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a side yet. Start with whichever one gets under your skin.
Everything's open. Take your pick. I'll act like I'm not watching.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little pressure.
live-some: {voted} down, {unvoted} to go. Keep moving. This is getting good.
You're in it now. {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start. The rest won't vote themselves. Sadly.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. You could finish this. Go on!
Almost there. {unvoted} more and you're done. Probably.
So close. Don't stop now. I'm invested.
live-one: One left. Just one. You can do it. I believe in you. Mostly.
Last one. Don't leave it hanging!
One match between you and done. Make it count.
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need you. Move!
The clock's loud now. {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of time. Pick quickly. Think later.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Look at you! Go see what the bracket looks like.
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens. I'll be here. Probably.
All done. That's rare. Thanks for sticking around.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again. Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. I don't trust it. Check back soon.
No matches open. Ugh. I'm bored already.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each go through. The rest... well, that's the messy bit.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone gets out. Hehe.
Watch the tables. They change fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon. The top two from every group go through. Ooh, here we go.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish first. Patience. Ugh.
The knockout builds itself once the groups end. Then things get interesting.
brackets-knockout-live: It's knockouts now. One loss and you're out. No pressure!
Single elimination. No second chances. Well, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't. I'm not your boss.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One loss and you're gone. That's the fun part. Right?
Follow the bracket. It gets tighter every round.
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Look at all that trouble.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup. Well, look at that. We made it.
It's over. Good run. ...I'm going to miss the noise.
That's the champion. All those matches, all that chaos. Worth it.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing's been drawn. Give it a moment.
Empty. The draw hasn't happened. Soon. I hope.
Nothing here yet. Check back. Try not to explode while waiting.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote, no take-backs. Pick a side on Arcane Moments.
Two edits are fighting. {a} versus {b}. Come on, settle it!
{a} versus {b}, and nobody can agree. Be the deciding vote. Make some trouble.
voted: I backed {pick} over {other}. Come and tell me I'm wrong. Go on. I dare you.
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Hehe. Disagree with me.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}. Be quick, it's quiet in here.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come and make it a proper fight.
Nobody's voted much on {pick} versus {other} yet. Go on. Start something.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote decides it. Guess whose.
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I can't watch. Come and break it. Actually, I can watch.
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody do something!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. My eye is twitching. Come and vote.
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Ooh, this is going to get loud.
So close: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. Fixable. Come on, help me fix it.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't done. Don't leave me doing this alone.
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. We can make a little noise.
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. That's a lot. Come on, rescue party!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs backup, and fast.
{pick} is getting buried by {other}. Well, I don't like that. Do you?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's close. Come and help me hold it.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let it slip!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to make me nervous.
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}. Come and watch it burn. Or join in.
{pick} is crushing {other}, {pct}%. Pick a side before it's over!
{pct}% for {pick}. {other} didn't see that coming. Hehe.
